name: Super Zenon Gamma 5
summary: Gamma 5 is an overheard scrolling shoot-em-up. The inhabitants of the M3 star have constructed a huge super-weapon known as the Devil Star. Clad in the newest mecha suit Gamma 5, the protagonist must infiltrate Devil Star and destroy the enemies within. The screen scrolls forward automatically; the player character can walk in all directions and shoot either forward or to the sides.
